messages: We’re bringing 14 people to town for a wedding. Can you help us book rooms at the same hotel?
I need to organize accommodation for our sales team—about eight rooms for the conference dates.
Could you hold a block of 20 rooms for our family reunion next July?
Hi, our soccer club is traveling with 16 players and a few parents. Is there a way to arrange everyone’s stay together?
Can you quote rates for 12 rooms, arriving Friday and leaving Sunday? We’re attending a work event nearby.
My daughter’s getting married, and relatives are coming from out of state. How do we set up a set of rooms under one booking?
We need lodging for a tour group of 25. Some guests may want to stay an extra night, but most will be there two nights.
Is it possible to reserve several rooms for our company’s annual meeting? We’re expecting around 30 attendees.
Our choir is traveling together in May. There are 11 of us, and we’d like rooms at the same property.
I’m coordinating a school trip for 18 students and three chaperones. What information do you need to arrange the rooms?

intents.name: special_room_request
messages: Would you be able to put me on one of the upper floors?
If possible, I’d love a room facing the ocean rather than the parking lot.
Could you note that we’d prefer rooms next to each other? We’re traveling with our kids.
I’m a light sleeper—could you place us away from the elevator if there’s availability?
Any chance of a room with a balcony? It’s our anniversary, though I know it may depend on what’s open.
Please make a note that I’d like a king bed and a quiet room, if available.
We’re hoping for a city view. Can that preference be added to my booking?
Could our two rooms be adjoining? We’ll be traveling with my elderly parents.
I’d prefer a room on a lower floor, ideally near the lobby. Is that something you can note?
The room in my confirmation is fine, but if a corner room opens up, I’d be interested.

intents.name: early_late_checkout
messages: My flight lands at 8 a.m. Is there any chance I could get into my room before the usual time?
Could I keep the room until 2 p.m. on Sunday instead of leaving in the morning?
I have a meeting right after I arrive. Would an earlier arrival to the room be possible?
What would it cost to stay in the room a few hours past the normal departure time?
We’ll get to town around 10, so I wanted to ask if the room might be ready then.
Our train isn’t until late afternoon. Could we hang on to the room a bit longer that day?
Can you arrange access before noon? I’m happy to pay extra if needed.
Would it be possible to leave around 1 p.m.? My kids have a swim meet and we need time to get ready.
We arrive on the red-eye and will be at the hotel early. Is there a way to get settled before the afternoon?
I have a late flight out—could I remain in the room until 4, or is there another option?

intents.name: stay_extension
messages: I’m already checked in through Thursday, but I’d like to add Friday night too. Can you update my stay?
My plans changed while I’m here. Could I keep this room for two more nights?
I’m in room 608 and need to stay until Monday now. Is that possible?
Could you extend my current booking by one night? I’d rather not move rooms.
I was supposed to leave tomorrow, but work has me here through the weekend. Can I add another night?
We’re having a great visit and want to remain here until the 18th. I’m already staying at the property.
Can I add Sunday night to the stay I’m currently in? Please let me know if the same room is available.
I need to remain at the hotel a few days longer than planned. Can you change my departure date?
I’m checked in for three nights and would like to make it five. Is there availability to continue in this room?
Something came up, so I won’t be leaving on Tuesday after all. Could you extend my booking through Wednesday?

intents.name: checkin_checkout_info
messages: What time do guests normally need to be out of their rooms?
When does the front desk start letting people check in?
Do I need to bring a passport, or is my driver’s license enough to check in?
I’ve booked online—where should I go when I arrive, and what do I need to show?
Is there a standard time when rooms are ready on arrival day?
Do you require the credit card used for the booking to be shown at the desk?
What time should I plan to leave on my last day? I’m arranging a ride to the airport.
Can my partner check in if the booking is under my name? What identification is required?
I’m arriving tonight; could you explain the usual arrival process at the front desk?
Is there anything besides a photo ID and payment card that I need to bring when I come to check in?

intents.name: hotel_amenities
messages: Does the hotel have a swimming pool, and is it open in the evenings?
Is there a fitness room guests can use during their stay?
Do you serve breakfast on site, or is there a restaurant in the building?
I’m planning a work trip—do you have meeting rooms or a business center?
Is parking available at the property? Also, is there a café where I can grab coffee in the morning?
Do you offer airport transportation, or will I need to book a taxi?
Are there laundry machines guests can use? I’ll be staying for a week.
Does the hotel have a bar, and what time does it usually close?
We’re bringing our bikes. Is there somewhere on-site where we can store them?
Is Wi-Fi included for guests, and do you have a gym with treadmills?

intents.name: accessibility_needs
messages: Do you have rooms that can accommodate someone who uses a wheelchair?
I have limited mobility. Is there step-free access from the entrance to the guest rooms?
Could you tell me whether the shower has grab bars and a seat?
My father uses a walker, so we’re looking for a room with a roll-in shower and enough space to move around.
Are there accessible parking spaces close to the entrance?
I’m hard of hearing. Do any rooms have visual alerts for the doorbell or fire alarm?
Can someone who uses a wheelchair get to the restaurant and pool without stairs?
We need a room with grab rails near the toilet and an accessible bathroom sink. Is that available?
My service dog will be with me, and I have mobility needs. Could you tell me about the easiest entrance to use?
Does the elevator accommodate a mobility scooter, and are there accessible rooms near it?

intents.name: housekeeping_request
messages: Could someone bring up two fresh towels when they have a chance?
Our room hasn’t been serviced today. Would you please have housekeeping stop by?
Can we get clean sheets? The ones on the bed got spilled on.
Please leave a couple of extra pillows and a blanket at room 412.
Would it be possible to have the bathroom cleaned this afternoon?
We’re running low on toilet paper and tissues. Could someone drop some off?
The trash bins are full, and we’d appreciate fresh towels too.
Could housekeeping replace the used coffee cups and restock the in-room coffee?
Please make up our room sometime after 11, if possible—we’ll be out for lunch.
I spilled some water on the floor, and the bath mat is soaked. Could we get a replacement and have it cleaned up?

intents.name: property_information
messages: How many bedrooms are upstairs, and is there a bathroom on the ground floor?
We’re bringing our toddler—does the staircase have a gate, and is the yard enclosed?
Is the rental suitable for someone who uses a wheelchair? I’m especially wondering about the entrance and bathroom.
Could you tell me whether the kitchen has a full-size oven? We’re planning to cook a big family dinner.
Are pets allowed, and are there any restrictions on where they can go inside?
Does the place have a washer and dryer, or should we plan to use a laundromat?
We’ll have six adults and two kids. Is there enough room for everyone to sleep comfortably?
Is parking included, and can a larger SUV fit in the driveway?
Just checking before we book: are there any quiet hours or other house rules we should know about?
How far is the cabin from the lake, and is the path down there manageable for older guests?

intents.name: amenity_support
messages: We can’t figure out how to turn on the fireplace. Is there a switch somewhere?
Could you explain how to operate the hot tub controls? The display is on, but the jets won’t start.
The oven has several symbols and we’re not sure which setting to use for baking. Any tips?
How do we get the coffee machine to brew? We added water and a pod, but nothing happens.
Is there a trick to lowering the bedroom blinds? The cord doesn’t seem to move them.
I’m trying to use the washer, but I can’t tell which compartment gets the detergent.
Where’s the remote for the ceiling fan? It’s warm in here and I can’t find a wall switch.
We’d like to use the grill tonight. How do you ignite it safely?
The thermostat is showing a schedule. How can we set the temperature for the rest of our stay?
Do you know how to switch the TV over to the HDMI input? We brought our own streaming device.

intents.name: internet_connectivity
messages: We can see the network name, but none of our devices will connect to it.
The Wi-Fi keeps dropping every few minutes, even though we’re sitting right beside the router.
Could you resend the network password? The one in the welcome book isn’t working.
We’re connected, but webpages won’t load at all. Is the service down in the area?
The internet has been extremely slow since we arrived, and video calls keep freezing.
Our phones connect, but the laptop says it can’t get an IP address. Any idea what to try?
Is there another network we should use? The listed one has disappeared from the available connections.
We restarted the router, but the connection still isn’t back. We need to work remotely tomorrow.
Wi-Fi says “connected without internet.” This started about an hour ago.
The signal in the back bedroom is almost nonexistent. Is there a booster or a better network to connect to?

intents.name: cleanliness_issue
messages: We just checked in, and there are crumbs and sticky spots all over the kitchen counter.
The sheets in the main bedroom look like they haven’t been changed; there are hairs on the pillowcases.
The bathroom wasn’t properly cleaned before we arrived. There’s grime around the sink and shower.
There’s a strong musty smell in the living room, and the rug looks stained.
We found food left in the fridge from the previous guests, and several shelves are sticky.
The towels in the closet are damp and smell unpleasant. We’ve only just arrived.
The floors are covered in sand and dirt, even though we haven’t taken our shoes off yet.
The house doesn’t look ready for guests—there’s dust on the furniture and a full trash bin.
I hate to complain, but the toilet has marks inside and the bathroom floor is dirty.
We arrived late and found used bedding piled in the bedroom. Could someone look into this?

intents.name: housekeeping_request
messages: Could we get a fresh set of towels brought up tomorrow? We’re staying for a week.
We’re running low on toilet paper. Is there another supply somewhere in the house?
Would it be possible to have the floors cleaned during our stay? We have a baby crawling around.
Can someone swap out the sheets in the main bedroom this afternoon?
We’ve used all the kitchen trash bags. Could you leave a few more for us?
Could we get a midweek tidy-up, please? We’ll be out for a couple of hours after lunch.
Is there a place to request extra blankets? The evenings have gotten colder than we expected.
We need more dishwasher tablets and paper towels. Could you drop some off when convenient?
Any chance we could have the bathroom towels refreshed today? No rush, just sometime before dinner.
Our stay is longer than planned, and we’d appreciate a quick clean and fresh linens later this week.

intents.name: maintenance_request
messages: The bathroom sink is draining very slowly. Could someone take a look when they have a chance?
One of the dining room chairs has a loose leg, so we’ve stopped using it.
The bedroom door handle keeps coming off when we turn it. It still closes, but it’s awkward.
The dishwasher starts its cycle and then stops after a few minutes.
A lightbulb in the hallway has burned out. Could it be replaced during our stay?
The sliding patio door is sticking and takes a lot of force to open.
The kitchen faucet drips steadily even when it’s turned off. It’s not flooding, but it’s annoying.
The dryer is running, but the clothes are still wet after a full cycle.
The closet shelf in the guest room has come loose from the wall. We’ve put everything on the floor for now.
The remote for the bedroom TV seems broken; none of the buttons respond, even with new batteries.

intents.name: urgent_property_issue
messages: Water is pouring through the ceiling above the living room right now. Please send help immediately.
There’s smoke coming from the electrical outlet by the kitchen counter, and it smells like burning.
A large tree branch has fallen across the only driveway, and we can’t safely get out.
The front door lock has jammed with us inside, and we can’t open it. This is urgent.
There’s a strong smell of gas near the stove. We’ve left the house—please tell us what to do next.
The toilet is overflowing and water is spreading across the bathroom floor fast.
We just saw sparks from the breaker panel. We’re keeping away from it; please respond right away.
The deck railing has come loose and someone nearly fell over the edge. No one is hurt, but it’s unsafe.
The carbon monoxide alarm is sounding. We’ve gone outside and need immediate instructions.
A window shattered during the storm, and broken glass is scattered inside the room.

intents.name: noise_neighbor_issue
messages: The people next door have had loud music playing for hours, and it’s keeping us awake.
There’s a group shouting outside our windows late at night. Could someone ask them to quiet down?
A nearby construction crew started very early this morning, and the noise is carrying into the bedrooms.
The neighbors’ dog has been barking nonstop since we arrived.
Someone in the unit above us keeps stomping and dragging furniture around after midnight.
There’s a party happening at the house across the street, with people yelling in the driveway.
We can hear loud machinery from a nearby property starting before sunrise. Is that usual here?
A neighbor has been revving a motorcycle outside repeatedly, and our kids can’t nap.
We don’t want to make a fuss, but the people next door are arguing loudly and banging on the shared wall.
There’s amplified music coming from the beach nearby, and it’s still going well past the posted quiet time.

intents.name: availability_inquiry
messages: Is the lake cabin free for July 12–16 for four adults?
Do you have anything open near the beach for the weekend of September 6?
We’re hoping to stay May 2–5 with two kids and a dog. Which homes have room?
Could you check whether the downtown apartment is open over Thanksgiving, arriving Wednesday and leaving Sunday?
Any chance the Cedar House is unbooked for the first week of August? There would be six of us.
Looking for somewhere for 3 adults from 10/14 to 10/18—what’s still open?
We may come up next month, probably Friday through Monday. Is the mountain place free then?
Hi, is the two-bedroom rental available for March 20–23? We’d need space for five.
Can you tell me if any of your homes are open for a family of eight during spring break?
We’re planning a quiet anniversary trip for June 9–12. Is the cottage already taken those nights?

intents.name: new_reservation_request
messages: I’d like to book the Seaview condo for August 8–12. What do you need from me?
Can you help me get a stay set up at one of your cabins for two people?
We’ve picked the Oak Street house. How do I go ahead and reserve it?
Please start a booking for the apartment we discussed; it’ll be me and my partner.
I’m ready to lock in a vacation rental for the long weekend. What’s the next step?
Could you put together a reservation for the beach house for our family of five?
That cottage looks perfect. I’d like to move forward with booking it for October.
We want to stay at the Pine Lodge from Dec 26 through Jan 2. Can you arrange the reservation?
How do I secure the two-bedroom place for our trip? We’re ready to commit.
Go ahead and set up a stay for us at the downtown loft, arriving May 3 and leaving May 7.

intents.name: reservation_status
messages: Could you confirm that my stay at Harbor House is on the books for June 4–8?
I can’t find the confirmation email. Would you resend the details for booking 58421?
What time does my reservation start, and how many guests are listed? I’m not trying to change anything.
Can you remind me of the address and dates attached to my existing booking?
Just checking that we’re all set for next weekend at the Maple Cabin.
I booked the Seaside Flat last month. Can you verify the reservation is confirmed?
Would you send me the receipt and booking reference for our upcoming stay?
Is my reservation under Morgan Lee still showing for the 18th through the 22nd?
I need the current details for our stay at the house in Bend, including the guest count.
Can you check what dates I have booked? I misplaced the confirmation, but everything should remain as is.

intents.name: reservation_change
messages: Our booking is for four, but my sister is joining us. Can you update it to five guests?
Could we shift our stay at the cottage from June 10–14 to June 12–16?
I need to add one night to my reservation, checking out on Monday instead of Sunday.
Would you change the booking name to Jamie Patel? The dates will stay the same.
We’ll now be bringing our dog. Can you add that to our existing reservation?
Can you switch us from the one-bedroom unit to the two-bedroom one on the same booking?
One of our kids can’t come anymore, so please update the guest total from five to four.
Is it possible to move our arrival date back by a day? We’re booked for the 7th right now.
Please add a request for a crib to our reservation; we’re traveling with a baby now.
The return flight changed, so we need to extend the rental through the 19th. Our reservation is under Chen.

intents.name: reservation_cancellation
messages: I need to cancel my booking for the River House next month. What should I do?
Please call off our reservation for July 3–7; we can no longer make the trip.
Could you cancel booking 73910? The family event was postponed.
I’m afraid we won’t be staying at the condo after all. Please cancel our reservation.
Can you remove our upcoming stay at the cabin from the schedule? We need to cancel.
We need to cancel the apartment booking under Alex Rivera, arriving on the 14th.
Our plans fell through. Please cancel the reservation for the weekend of May 20.
I’d like to withdraw from the stay I booked for next month. Let me know if you need anything else.
Please cancel our booking at the beach house; we won’t be traveling anymore.
The trip is off, so I need the reservation canceled. It’s under the name Jordan.

intents.name: arrival_departure_timing
messages: What’s the usual time we can get into the rental on arrival day?
Would it be possible to arrive around noon instead of the normal time?
When do we need to be out of the house on checkout day?
Our flight lands at 10 a.m. Is there a way to get into the condo early?
Could we keep the cabin until 1 p.m. on Sunday, or is that too late?
What time is check-in at the property? I’m planning the drive from Portland.
We have a late flight home—can we leave our bags there after checkout?
Is a later departure available on the 18th? We have lunch plans nearby.
We may not arrive until after midnight. Is that okay, and when does the arrival window begin?
Can we request a couple extra hours before leaving? Our train doesn’t leave until 3.

intents.name: access_instructions
messages: Where will I find the keypad code for the front door before we arrive?
Could you send directions to the cabin? The map app is taking us to the wrong road.
How do we get into the building after the front desk closes?
I received the welcome email but don’t see the instructions for opening the lockbox.
What’s the process for using the pool gate and the gym during our stay?
Please let me know where to pick up the keys and how to reach the rental from the parking area.
Do we need a code or a key to enter the garage?
Can you explain how to access the private beach from the property?
We’re arriving tomorrow—where should we go to collect the keys?
Could you resend the door entry details and the directions to the unit?

intents.name: locked_out
messages: We’re at the front door and the code we were given won’t unlock it. Can someone help?
I can’t get inside—the key is turning but the lock isn’t opening.
We’re locked out of the condo, and our bags are still inside. Please call me.
The keypad is flashing red and won’t accept the entry code. We’re standing outside now.
I shut the door behind me and the keys are on the kitchen counter. What should I do?
The keybox won’t open, even though I’m entering the right combination. We need access.
I’m outside the rental in the rain and the smart lock seems dead. Can you send help?
None of the keys in the lockbox fit the front door. I can’t get in.
Our code worked earlier, but now the door won’t open and we’re stuck in the hallway.
Help, we can’t enter the house—the electronic lock keeps beeping and rejecting the code.

intents.name: event_space_availability
messages: Is the Harbor Ballroom free on October 18?
Could you check whether the Cedar Room is open for a breakfast meeting on May 6?
We’re considering your hotel for our annual retreat. Do you have a space available the afternoon of June 12?
Any chance the Lakeside Suite is still open for a reception on the 22nd?
I’m looking at dates for a product launch—would the Grand Hall be free on September 9?
Do you have anything suitable for a 40-person workshop available on Thursday, April 3?
Before we finalize travel, can you tell me if the Terrace Room is taken on July 14?
Is the ballroom already booked for the evening of November 2? We’d need it from about 5 to 10.
We might move our board meeting to the 16th. Would the Oak Conference Room be open that day?
Checking a couple of options: is there a meeting room available on March 27, or are you fully booked?

intents.name: event_space_booking
messages: Please reserve the Harbor Ballroom for our awards dinner on October 18.
We’d like to lock in the Cedar Room for May 6, 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.
Can you move our workshop from the Lakeside Suite to the Grand Hall? The date stays June 12.
Please cancel the room we’re holding for the board meeting on April 3.
Could you book the Terrace Room for a welcome reception on July 14? We’re expecting about 60 guests.
The client confirmed—go ahead and secure the Oak Conference Room for September 9.
We need to change our Friday meeting reservation to Saturday morning, same room if possible.
Please release our ballroom booking for November 2; the event has been called off.
I’d like to reserve your smaller meeting room for a planning session on March 27, from 2 to 5.
Can you switch our reception booking to the evening of the 22nd? We’re still hoping to use the Lakeside Suite.

intents.name: event_space_layout
messages: How many people can the Cedar Room hold with tables set up?
Could you send over a floor plan for the Harbor Ballroom?
We’re planning a classroom-style workshop for 48. Is that seating arrangement possible in the Oak Room?
What’s the maximum number of guests for a dinner with round tables in the Grand Hall?
Can the chairs be arranged in a U-shape, with a table for presenters at the open end?
Do you have a diagram showing where the pillars and doors are in the Terrace Room?
We’ll need rows of seats facing a stage. How many attendees would fit in that setup?
Is it possible to divide the Lakeside Suite into two smaller sections, and what would each side hold?
For our 30-person discussion, could we use one large boardroom table instead of separate tables?
The guest count may reach 120. What table arrangement works best in your ballroom?

intents.name: guest_room_block
messages: Could you set aside 25 guest rooms for our conference attendees on October 17 and 18?
We need a room block for a wedding group, about 40 rooms for the weekend of May 6.
Can you increase our attendee allotment from 30 rooms to 45? The event registration is moving quickly.
Would you hold 18 rooms for speakers arriving June 11 and leaving June 13?
Our conference is expecting more out-of-town guests. Can we add ten rooms to the group allocation?
Please reduce the block for our September meeting from 50 rooms to 35; several people are staying elsewhere.
What rates can you offer if we set aside 60 rooms for the association’s annual gathering?
Could you arrange a group allotment for our team, arriving the night before the summit and checking out Friday?
We’ve got a few more delegates coming. Is it possible to extend our room block through Sunday?
Please release the unclaimed rooms from our event group allotment after the cutoff date.

intents.name: individual_room_reservation
messages: I’m attending the sales conference—can I book one room for myself for October 17?
I already have a room for May 5, but I need to add a night at the end of my stay.
Please cancel my individual reservation for June 11; I can no longer attend the seminar.
Could you change my arrival date to September 8? My confirmation number is 48271.
I’ll be speaking at the retreat and need a single room for two nights, arriving July 13.
Can I reserve a king room for just me during the three-day workshop?
I booked a room under Morgan Lee for the convention, but need to switch checkout from Friday to Saturday.
Hi, I need to cancel my own hotel room for the November 2 conference, not the event booking.
Is it possible to add my partner to my room reservation for the weekend of the meeting?
I’m coming in early to help with setup. Could you add one night to my existing booking?

intents.name: catering_menu_options
messages: Could you send me the catering menus for a lunchtime conference?
What breakfast choices do you offer for groups? We’re expecting around 35 people.
Do you have plated dinner packages, or is the evening meal served buffet-style?
We’re planning a coffee break between sessions. What snacks and drinks can we choose from?
Can you share your reception menu, including the available hors d’oeuvres?
What are the beverage options for a morning meeting—coffee, tea, juice, that sort of thing?
We may want a three-course lunch for our delegates. Could you provide the package selections and prices?
Are boxed lunches available, or do you only offer a buffet for conference groups?
Please send details on the bar packages for our awards evening. We’re also finalizing the program.
What kinds of desserts can be included with a dinner service?

intents.name: dietary_accommodations
messages: Can you provide a gluten-free meal for one of our attendees?
One guest has a severe peanut allergy. How do you handle that with the kitchen?
We have several vegan participants; can their meals be prepared separately?
Could the lunch include options suitable for people who avoid dairy?

intents.name: audio_visual_equipment
messages: Can we have a projector and screen for the keynote presentation?
Does the Cedar Room have wireless microphones available?
We’ll need a speaker system that can cover the ballroom for our panel discussion.
Can you provide a laptop connection for slides, preferably HDMI?
Is there stage lighting we can use for the awards ceremony?
Could we rent a handheld mic and a lectern microphone for the afternoon session?
Do you have a large display monitor we can connect to for a small workshop?
We’re showing a short video during dinner. What playback equipment can your team supply?
Will someone from your technical staff be available to help with the presentation setup?
Can the lights be dimmed in the meeting room while keeping the presenters visible?

intents.name: event_technology_support
messages: Will the ballroom Wi-Fi handle about 150 people streaming a live demo?
Could someone help us connect a MacBook to the projector before the keynote?
We’re bringing a hybrid panel—can the room support video calls with remote speakers?

Is there a way to get a dedicated internet connection for our product demonstration?
Sorry, quick question while I’m finalizing the slides: can someone assist with sound and screen setup during our session?

intents.name: event_schedule_changes
messages: Could we move the afternoon break from 2:30 to 3:00?
The keynote is running longer than expected. Please shift the breakout sessions back by 20 minutes.
Can you update our agenda so registration opens at 8 instead of 8:30?

Would it be possible to add a 15-minute networking slot before dinner?
I sent the latest program yesterday, but one session has the wrong start time—can you correct it?
We’re still confirming speakers, but could you pencil in a second breakout at 11:30?

intents.name: event_setup_teardown
messages: How early can our team get into the ballroom on Thursday to prepare?
Could the tables be arranged classroom-style before we arrive?

After the reception, when do we need to have all our materials cleared out?
Would your team be able to place the chairs before registration starts at 7 a.m.?

Please let me know when vendors can load in and where they should check in.

intents.name: attendee_accessibility
messages: Is there a step-free route from the lobby to the conference rooms?

Are the meeting-room doors wide enough for a mobility scooter?
Could you tell me where the accessible restrooms are in relation to the ballroom?
We have an attendee with limited vision; can you provide large-print versions of the room directions?
Does the hotel have elevators that reach the event level?
A guest will need a seat with extra space for a service dog. Can that be arranged?
Is there an accessible entrance that avoids the stairs by the main doors?

intents.name: parking_transportation
messages: Is there parking at the hotel, and how much does it cost per day?

intents.name: returning_student_enrollment
